subject: Verification artifacts for recent security fixes and mitigations
messages:
From: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@finteam.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finteam.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Verification artifacts for recent security fixes — FinTeam

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the update in last week's call. As part of FinTeam's vendor security review (SIG/SOC2 scope) we need concrete artifacts that verify the fixes you implemented for the issues flagged in the penetration test (see ticket references in the attached summary). Specifically we need: 

- Screenshots of the admin config pages showing the corrected settings (redacted where necessary)
- Exported config snippets (nginx / ingress rules, WAF rules, auth provider config) with lines changed highlighted or noted
- JIRA ticket exports showing remediation work (IDs and closure comments)
- Date/time-stamped evidence of the retest run (pen test vendor confirmation)
- Short description of compensating controls you have in place (WAF/IPS rules, logging/alerting changes, temporary mitigations)

Can you provide these artifacts in the next 7 business days? Also include any notes we should add to our SOC 2 evidence binder. If anything needs to be redacted for customer privacy, call that out and provide a rationale.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Paul Nguyen
Director, Infrastructure Security
FinTeam Financial

Attachments: finteam-pen-summary-0420.pdf (summary of issues)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Paul,

Thanks — we can absolutely provide the items you listed. I'll coordinate with Eng & Security and aim to get a consolidated package within 5 business days (target: Tue 2027-04-27).

Quick notes: we'll provide redacted screenshots and a config diff (sanitized). For the JIRA export we'll include ticket IDs and closure comments; we'll avoid attaching any customer PII. Aditya (Engineering) and Lauren (Security Ops) are on copy — Aditya will collect the artifacts and Lauren will validate them against our SOC2 evidence checklist.

If you prefer a separate drive folder with read-only access for the FinTeam security reviewers, let me know and I'll share it.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Head of Sales (Platform)
Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding FinTeam's request (below). Can you assemble the artifacts and a short write-up on compensating controls? Customer specifically asked for: screenshots, config snippets/diff, JIRA ticket export with closure comments, and evidence of the retest (pen test vendor confirmation).

Acceptance criteria for the package:
- Screenshots: admin view with changed settings visible; redact any user identifiers; annotate changed fields
- Config diff: 'before/after' lines (or excerpt) with path and line numbers where feasible
- Tickets: JIRA IDs + status + closure comment; export as CSV attachments and include permalinks
- Retest evidence: vendor email/report stub with timestamp (we can attach Acme's retest PDF)
- Compensating controls: 3–4 bullet summary (why they mitigate residual risk, how monitored)

Operational notes: security should validate logs for the remediation window (we need the timeframe so customer's SOC2 team can verify change records). If we need to mask internal IPs, note that in the package and include an explanation.

Timeline: please aim to have the draft package to me by EOD Mon 2027-04-26 so I can review and send to FinTeam on Tue 2027-04-27. If this slips, communicate ASAP.

Thanks — Logan

Logan / Lauren —

Attached is the remediation package draft we assembled:

Attachments (stubs):
- fix-screenshots-0427.zip (sanitized admin screen captures; annotations included)
- config-diff-0427.txt (nginx ingress rules and WAF rule excerpt; lines with changes marked with >>>)
- JIRA-3876-3890-export.csv (ticket export with closure comments and timestamps)
- pen-test-retest-report-acme-0425.pdf (Acme Pen Test retest confirmation; redacted)

Key notes for the FinTeam binder:
- Fix summary: two issues flagged in the original test (privilege escalation via admin endpoint and insufficient WAF rules) were remediated. Patches deployed to prod on 2027-04-21 at 03:40 UTC.
- Retest: Acme Pen Test completed a targeted retest on 2027-04-25; they validated the vector and provided a short retest confirmation (attached).
- Tickets: JIRA-3876 (fix: admin endpoint auth checks) & JIRA-3890 (WAF rule tuning). Both have closure comments and PR links in the CSV.
- Compensating controls (short):
  * WAF rule set tightened (rate + signature match) — alerted at severity=high
  * Continuous monitoring: new alert rule on anomalous admin endpoint requests (threshold-based + ML anomaly score)
  * Access controls: added short-lived tokens for owner/admin flows with enforced MFA for console access
  * Auditability: retention of admin access logs extended to 13 months for compliance review

Sanitization: screenshots and config excerpts have been redacted to remove internal hostnames and customer identifiers. We documented the redaction map in the Drive link below.

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/finteam-redacted-logs-20270427

If this looks good I recommend we return the package to FinTeam with a 1-page cover memo explaining the items and the compensating controls rationale.

-Aditya
Senior Engineer, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Paul —

Thanks for your patience. Attaching the remediation package we discussed. Items included below (all redacted/sanitized where noted):

- fix-screenshots-0427.zip (sanitized admin UI captures; annotations show changed fields and values)
- config-diff-0427.txt (nginx/WAF excerpts with >>> markers for changed lines)
- JIRA-3876-3890-export.csv (ticket IDs, timestamps, closure comments; permalinks included in CSV)
- pen-test-retest-report-acme-0425.pdf (Acme retest confirmation — redacted vendor report stub)

Short compensating controls summary (for your SOC2 binder):
1) WAF and rate-limit rules: tuned to block the enumerated vectors; alerts created for high-frequency requests to the admin endpoint.
2) Monitoring and alerting: new anomaly detection and an on-call runbook for admin endpoint suspicious activity.
3) Access posture: forced MFA for admin console and rotation of long-lived tokens; short-lived session tokens enforced.
4) Auditability: extended admin access log retention to 13 months; retained integrity hashes for change records.

We have also shared a read-only Drive folder with a redaction map and a short cover memo: https://drive.google.com/finteam-redacted-logs-20270427

If you need additional detail (e.g., raw logs with a non-disclosure addendum) we can arrange that under a limited-access share. Happy to hop on a call to walk through the artifacts — are you available Tue 2027-05-03 10:00 AM ET?

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Sales (Platform)
